chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Aban, who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah عليه السلام saying: “The world will not pass away until a man from me emerges, who will judge with the judgment of the family of Dawud عليه السلام, and he will not ask for proof; he will give every soul its due right.”

key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: the present worldly life before its end
key_terms.بِحُكُومَةِ آلِ دَاوُدَ: with the mode of judgment of the family of Dawud عليه السلام
key_terms.حَقَّهَا: its due right or rightful entitlement
key_terms.رَجُلٌ: a man, referring here to the promised descendant from the Imam
key_terms.مِنِّي: from me, meaning from my lineage

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith in al-Kafi say about the future ruler from the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام who will judge like the family of Dawud عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith foretells the emergence of a man from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام's line before the end of the world, who will govern with divinely guided judgment. It emphasizes perfect justice, in which every soul is given its due without reliance on ordinary evidentiary procedures.
